notes.title: What's next after Office Rivals?
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Office Rivals had passed the eligibility to have Community Items, so this VN now has trading cards, wallpapers, badges and emoticons! Yay![/p][p]It's been approximately 4 months since release, thank you very much to those who have played, left a review, and expressed interest in my future works.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/fZhkWzc.png"][/img][i]You might recognize some of the side characters in Office Rivals here, along with Nanako herself![/i][/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoyed the slice-of-life and doujin-inspired experience of playing Office Rivals, don't hesitate to spend just a minute to drop a review, as it would be helpful for me to gauge interest and keep making something you enjoy! This way, I can be sure that the slice-of-life genre like this has an engaged audience![/p][p]So what have I been up to and what can you expect in the future? After the release of Office Rivals had settled down, I decided to take a much needed break. Office Rivals took 2 years to develop, and it was quite an upgrade from my first VN (Office Rivals is my 2nd VN but the 1st to go on Steam).[/p][p][/p][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]Right now I'm working on my next VN! In fact, during my 3-month break in June, July, and August, I was actually doing a lot of improvement work and experimentations, and learning new things, and making my art better![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/X2b9hCG.png"][/img][/p][p][i]The Heart City Stories is an anthology in a shared universe, with various recurring characters.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I will announce more details soon. In my next blogpost, I will also talk a little bit about the game's universe, love interests, and other characters and stories so you can have a picture on what to expect in the future! In the meantime, feel free to drop a review which is much needed for a small dev like myself, and to help Steam algorithm as well.[/p][p]Also, I will release some extra CGs for Office Rivals in the upcoming days![/p][p]I'm excited to continue creating this kind of VN, and expand the catalogue of my works on my [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/parkedhearts"]Steam page[/url]![/p][p]Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Thank you and feel free to leave a review!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Dev here!

Thank you for playing Office Rivals! It's actually my second VN, and my first Steam release. If you had an enjoyable story experience, leaving a review would help tremendously! Even a short review means a lot!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8WBaRZi.png[/img]

For Office Rivals, every review matters! It gives better visibility and helps Steam algorithm to show it to more players who might enjoy it! A win-win for everyone, and it'll definitely motivate me as I'm working on my next project!

Please stay tuned and follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/parkedhearts]my developer page[/url] to get notified about my next project! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Office Rivals is live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Office Rivals is live now!

After 2 years of development, I'm happy to say that Office Rivals has finished its major development! Thank you for your interest! If you encounter any bugs or errors, please let me know! Otherwise, I hope you have an enjoyable story experience!

notes.title: Please look forward to the release in May!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Last month, Office Rivals participated in the Steam Next Fest as well as Visual Novel Fest. I hope you tried the demo, and if you have, I hope you had an enjoyable experience! Please take note that the demo does not reflect the final version. The final version is a lot longer (90k to 100k words), and the art quality in the demo will be improved in the release version.

Office Rivals is a story-first visual novel, with focus on conversations, friendships, and everyday emotions. But you can also expect steamy scenes as well! Every Chapter has at least one H-scene, and every scene has several animations.

Office Rivals will be released around late May. I'll announce the exact date soon. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: Office Rivals development update: Chapter 4 has been completed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thanks for your interest in the visual novel and for adding us to your wishlist! At the moment, I have finished the 4th Chapter of the VN, and there's only one Chapter left to work on.

[list]
[*] Total word count (at the moment): Approx. 96,000 words
[*] Animation: Approx. 30 h-animations, consisting of 700 components.
[*] Art: Over 400 CGs
[/list]

It's been a long road and I'm truly excited to reach the finish line of Nanako's story! Office Rivals will also participate in the upcoming Visual Novel Fest, please wish me luck! I hope this VN will be visible to more VN players especially fans of wholesome doujinshi and webtoons, as these are the influences that Office Rivals carries on its sleeves!

Please try out the demo, and if you have done so, I hope you look forward to more!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Greetings!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's me, the developer of Office Rivals here! Thank you for your interest! This visual novel has been in development for quite some time now, which is almost 2 years.

As you can see, it is very faithful to its inspirations, which are slice-of-life doujinshi and webtoons centered around the office life. If you enjoyed works such as "[i]Dusty Miller[/i]" by Hiroya, "[i]I Knocked Up the Lady from My Office[/i]" by Special G, "[i]More Than A Sex Friend, Less Than A Fiancée[/i]" by Saru no Koshikake, or "[i]Muramatasan's Secret[/i]" by Igumox, and many other OL-themed doujinshi, then you're going to enjoy Office Rivals as well.

Currently, I'm working on completing the 4th chapter of this visual novel, which is almost completed at this point. Next, I'll move on to the 5th chapter, and then Office Rivals will be ready for release.

Oh, and Office Rivals will be a part of the Steam Next Fest and the Visual Novel Fest! There will be a demo available for you to try. Do note that it's still work in progress!

If it piques your interest, please keep it in your wishlist!
Stay tuned!
